01-chaim-soutine.jpg.title: Chaim Soutine
01-chaim-soutine.jpg.alt: Shown from the lap up, a cleanshaven man with black hair and dark clothes faces us as he sits with his hands resting together in his lap in this stylized, vertical portrait painting.
01-chaim-soutine.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Chaim Soutine, 1918. National Gallery of Art.

02-woman-with-red-hair.jpg.title: Woman with Red Hair
02-woman-with-red-hair.jpg.alt: Shown from the lap up, a woman with peach-colored skin sits leaning sideways against the back of a wooden chair with her head tilted to our left on her long neck in this vertical, stylized portrait.
02-woman-with-red-hair.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Woman with Red Hair, 1917. National Gallery of Art.

01-madame-am-d-e-woman-with-cigarette.jp.title: Madame Amédée (Woman with Cigarette)
01-madame-am-d-e-woman-with-cigarette.jp.alt: This painting shows a portrait of a woman, depicted from the thighs up.
01-madame-am-d-e-woman-with-cigarette.jp.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Madame Amédée (Woman with Cigarette), 1918. National Gallery of Art.

02-caf-singer.jpg.title: Café Singer
02-caf-singer.jpg.alt: Shown from the knees up, a woman wearing a black dress is painted with areas of mottled color in this vertical painting.
02-caf-singer.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Café Singer, 1917. National Gallery of Art.

03-madame-kisling.jpg.title: Madame Kisling
03-madame-kisling.jpg.alt: This vertical portrait painting shows the head and shoulders of a person with pale peach skin and an auburn, cheek-length bob hairstyle.
03-madame-kisling.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Madame Kisling, c. 1917. National Gallery of Art.

04-l-on-bakst.jpg.title: Léon Bakst
04-l-on-bakst.jpg.alt: This painting is a portrait showing a man from the chest up.
04-l-on-bakst.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Léon Bakst, 1917. National Gallery of Art.

05-adrienne-woman-with-bangs.jpg.title: Adrienne (Woman with Bangs)
05-adrienne-woman-with-bangs.jpg.alt: A woman with peachy skin and dark auburn hair is shown from her chest up sitting in a wooden chair in this vertical portrait painting.
05-adrienne-woman-with-bangs.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Adrienne (Woman with Bangs), 1917. National Gallery of Art.

01-girl-in-a-green-blouse.jpg.title: Girl in a Green Blouse
01-girl-in-a-green-blouse.jpg.alt: Shown from the lap up, a pale-skinned woman with an oval face and long neck sits facing us in this vertical painting.
01-girl-in-a-green-blouse.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Girl in a Green Blouse, 1917. National Gallery of Art.

02-monsieur-deleu.jpg.title: Monsieur Deleu
02-monsieur-deleu.jpg.alt: Shown from the lap up, a person with peach-colored skin sits facing us as he looks down and to our left in this vertical, stylized, portrait painting.
02-monsieur-deleu.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Monsieur Deleu, 1916. National Gallery of Art.

03-roma-woman-with-baby.jpg.title: Roma Woman with Baby
03-roma-woman-with-baby.jpg.alt: Shown from the knees up, a woman with peach-colored skin and dark hair sits facing us and holding a baby in this stylized, vertical portrait painting.
03-roma-woman-with-baby.jpg.description: Amedeo Modigliani. Roma Woman with Baby, 1919. National Gallery of Art.
